request.what: Treasury withdrawal for Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 covering 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The funded work is scoped to maintaining Cardano hardware-wallet compatibility, tooling, release support, supporting libraries, security, and vendor-required audits rather than building a new wallet product.

The proposer states that continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution, Ledger and Trezor changes, and wallet or dApp integration demand create compatibility risk for secure user access.
The proposer states that the proposal does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposer states that the withdrawal does not, at submission time, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will administer the withdrawn funds through a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with listed stake and payment addresses.
The proposal names an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl to verify key administrative actions using on-chain logic.
The proposal states that TRSC disbursement requires authorization from two of five Intersect admins, three of six trusted entities, and two of three Intersect leadership signers.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is provided for community audit of the TRSC or PSSC and tracking of metrics related to the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for 2026 continuity maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet support, administered by Intersect through treasury smart contracts with milestone controls, oversight roles, and several external references for voting, audits, contracts, and tracking.
